source.query: Cala knowledge query (api.cala.ai/v1/knowledge/query), rows carry no source URLs

rules: No score or ranking of people. Metrics are facts from dated Cala edges with neutral labels.
Every person shows its Cala entity id, fetch date and the source of each role.
Missing dates and possible name collisions are listed as gaps, never filled in.
Patterns are descriptive counts over this sample with their n, not benchmarks.

consulting.label: Management consulting
consulting.source: Hand list: MBB (McKinsey, BCG, Bain), the Big Four audit firms and other large strategy firms. Not exhaustive.

big_tech.label: Big tech

research.label: University or research lab
research.source: Employer name contains a university or public research lab name. Keyword list.

finance.label: Investment banking or investing
finance.source: Global investment banks and employers whose name says ventures or private equity. Keyword list.

metrics.employers: Distinct organisations in the person's WORKS_AT and FOUNDED edges
metrics.avg_tenure_years: Mean of (valid_until minus valid_since) over roles that have both dates
metrics.level_ups: Times a dated role maps to a higher title level than the dated role before it
metrics.level_ups_per_year: level_ups divided by years between first and last dated role start; only when that span is at least one year
metrics.years_before_company: Years from the first dated role elsewhere to the first dated role at the company this person was found through
metrics.roles_outside_company: WORKS_AT edges to organisations other than the company the person was found through (background tags only use these)

coverage.note: In-snapshot cohort matches are by company name only and may be a different company of the same name.
